## Parameters
```{r parameters}
years <- 1970:2021
lonLim <- c(-9.5, 4.3)
latLim <- c(36, 44)
dataset <- "ERA5"
```

## Library
```{r library, cache=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
source("/lustre/gmeteo/WORK/urrutxuai/R2/load_data.R")
library(visualizeR)
devtools::load_all("/lustre/gmeteo/WORK/urrutxuai/test/transformeR") # instead of library(transformeR)
```

## PCA
```{r}
# ISI
dat_era_isi <- load_data(year = years, lonLim = lonLim, latLim = latLim, what = "ISI", dataset = dataset)
clim <- climatology(dat_era_isi)
# BUI
dat_era_bui <- load_data(year = years, lonLim = lonLim, latLim = latLim, what = "BUI", dataset = dataset)

# convert to ("time", "point")
data_isi <- matrix(dat_era_isi$Data, nrow = dim(dat_era_isi$Data)[1])
data_bui <- matrix(dat_era_bui$Data, nrow = dim(dat_era_bui$Data)[1])

rm(dat_era_isi)
rm(dat_era_bui)

# remove points with NA values
keep_points <- which(colSums(is.na(data_isi)) == 0)
data_isi <- t(data_isi[, keep_points])
data_bui <- t(data_bui[, keep_points])

# scale data
data_isi <- scale(data_isi)
data_bui <- scale(data_bui)

# combine ISI and BUI
data_combined <- cbind(data_isi, data_bui)
rm(data_isi, data_bui)

# compute PCA
pca_combined <- prcomp(data_combined, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

rm(data_combined)

pca_combined_var <- pca_combined$sdev^2
pca_combined_var_explained <- pca_combined_var / sum(pca_combined_var)
cumulative_var_explained <- cumsum(pca_combined_var_explained)
num_components <- which(cumulative_var_explained >= 0.95)[1]
pca_combined_reduced <- pca_combined$x[, 1:num_components]
num_components

rm(pca_combined)

plot(cumulative_var_explained, type = "b", xlab = "Number of Principal Components", ylab = "Cumulative Variance Explained", main = "PCA Variance Explained")

plot(cumulative_var_explained[1:num_components], type = "b", xlab = "Number of Principal Components", ylab = "Cumulative Variance Explained", main = "PCA Variance Explained")
```

```{r}
clusters_to_grid <- function(cluster, keep_points, grid_dim) {
  cluster_full <- rep(NA_integer_, prod(grid_dim))
  cluster_full[keep_points] <- cluster
  array(cluster_full, dim = grid_dim)
}

grid_dim <- dim(clim$Data)[-1]
wcss <- numeric(9)
set.seed(123)

for (k in 2:10) {
  km <- kmeans(pca_combined_reduced, centers = k, nstart = 25)
  clim_plot <- clim
  clim_plot$Data[1,,] <- clusters_to_grid( km$cluster, keep_points, grid_dim)
  spatialPlot(clim_plot, backdrop.theme = "countries", main = paste("Clusters of ISI and BUI with k =", k) )
  wcss[k - 1] <- km$tot.withinss
}
plot(2:10, wcss, type = "b", xlab = "Number of Clusters (k)", ylab = "Total Within-Cluster Sum of Squares")
```

```{r save}
k <- 3
set.seed(123)
km <- kmeans(pca_combined_reduced, centers = k, nstart = 25)

clim$Data[1,,] <- clusters_to_grid(km$cluster, keep_points, grid_dim)

print(spatialPlot(clim, backdrop.theme = "countries", main = paste("Clusters of ISI and BUI with k =", k)))

saveRDS(clim, "/lustre/gmeteo/WORK/urrutxuai/TFM/region_k3.rds")
```

```{r}
library(raster)
library(terra)

region_obj <- readRDS("/lustre/gmeteo/WORK/urrutxuai/R2/region_k3.rds")

# Create raster from cluster grid
r <- raster(
  nrows = length(region_obj$xyCoords$y),
  ncols = length(region_obj$xyCoords$x),
  xmn   = min(region_obj$xyCoords$x) - 0.05,
  xmx   = max(region_obj$xyCoords$x) + 0.05,
  ymn   = min(region_obj$xyCoords$y) - 0.05,
  ymx   = max(region_obj$xyCoords$y) + 0.05,
  crs   = CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84")
)

values(r) <- as.vector(t(drop(region_obj$Data)[nrow(drop(region_obj$Data)):1, ]))

r <- rast(r)

# Convert each cluster to a dissolved polygon
cluster_polys <- lapply(1:3, function(k) {
  r_k <- r
  r_k[r_k != k] <- NA
  as.polygons(r_k, dissolve = TRUE)
})

clusters <- do.call(rbind, cluster_polys)
clusters$name <- c("N", "E", "SW")

# Smooth boundaries
clusters <- simplifyGeom(clusters, tolerance = 0.1)

# Save shapefile
writeVector(clusters, "/lustre/gmeteo/WORK/urrutxuai/TFM/cluster_regions.shp", overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(sp)
library(raster)
library(terra)
clusters_sp <- as(vect("/lustre/gmeteo/WORK/urrutxuai/TFM/cluster_regions.shp"), "Spatial")
print(spatialPlot(clim, backdrop.theme = "countries", main = paste("Clusters of ISI and BUI with k =", k),
                  sp.layout = list(list(clusters_sp, first = FALSE, col = "black", lwd = 1.5))))
```
